facts: Every official track contains six physical obstacles, so the three current videos cannot test an obstacle-count versus lap-time relationship.
A collision adds20-percent damage and degrades grip, engine and steering from the first collision; the fifth collision retires the car.
Grass friction is0.6. A brief grass excursion is not an immediate disqualification, but101 consecutive negative-reward action steps or leaving the play area retires the car.
Finished entries rank by simulated lap time; every non-finish ranks behind a finish.

video_evidence.interpretation: Obstacle-local slowdown is directionally supported, but the videos do not causally separate braking, steering or path length. Absolute inter-track time is primarily explained by track length, not obstacle count.

current_candidate_limit.reason: The controller postdates every available evaluation video, so this follow-up must remain a bounded static-only diagnostic.

accepted.change: Increase only the eligible adaptive compound target ceiling from36 to38 by subclassing the current controller.
accepted.rationale: This removes at most2 additional target-speed units in the already-qualified far/moderate regime, remains below the existing target40 used for near noncompound obstacles and clear-curve floor, and leaves all steering and recovery behavior unchanged.

rejected: Intentional off-road line: not an explicit rule violation by itself, but grass friction and terminal off-track risk make it an unsupported pace strategy.
More aggressive obstacle steering: can reduce clearance, cross the existing strong-steer speed veto and regress the historical collision/off-track failures.
Global target or brake increase: rendered clearances are tight and the current adaptive candidate has not yet received a bound closed-loop evaluation.
Obstacle-count explanation: all official tracks contain six obstacles and current normalized pace is nearly constant across the three videos.
limitations: No available video is bound to the current agent source, model hash, package hash or internal actions.
Video speed is a rendered-motion proxy, not physical simulator speed.
The competition website was unavailable; official repository commit dfb7a2d is the verified source.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent.
